  var overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'nav-blur-overlays';
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);

  var dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.navbar6_menu-dropdown.w-dropdown');
  if (!dropdowns.length) return;

  dropdowns.forEach(function (dropdown) {
    dropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
      overlay.classList.add('active');
    });
    dropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
      overlay.classList.remove('active');
    });
  });
});
</script></div><div class="global-code_wrap"><div class="w-embed"><style>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('[pop-up="true"]').forEach(trigger => {
    trigger.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const img = trigger.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;
      const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'pu-backdrop';
      backdrop.style.cssText = 'transition: opacity 300ms; opacity: 0;';
      backdrop.innerHTML = `
        <div class="pu-container">
          <div class="pu-content">
            <div class="pu-view" tabindex="0" style="opacity: 1;">
              <div class="pu-frame">
                <figure class="pu-figure">
                  <img class="pu-img" src="${img.src}" alt="${img.alt || ''}">
                </figure>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="pu-control pu-close" role="button" aria-label="close lightbox" tabindex="0"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { backdrop.style.opacity = '1'; });
      });
      const close = () => {
        backdrop.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => {
          backdrop.remove();
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }, 300);
      };
      backdrop.querySelector('.pu-close').addEventListener('click', close);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (e.target === backdrop) close();
      });
      const onKeyDown = e => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          close();
          document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    });
  });
});
</script>
